description: Sets of allowed DUMP_OFF request states only, not MOS gate action or current. In R1 UCC IN+ is GUARD_OK; GUARD low blocks both hardware and software requests. No unknown state is declared a failure.

rows.event: stable early rail, LPV low, PB7 high
CORE crosses undefined startup region while early rail on
rows.note: ADG [0] only if independent supervisor already valid and its low output has proven current margin

rows.event: early rail ramps, independent supervisor starts late
rows.note: intermediate ADG VDD and guard output outside stated guarantee; UCC may leave UVLO, physical MOS conduction not asserted

rows.event: early rail valid, software blocked, hardware OV
rows.note: only the hard request pulls DUMP_OFF, bypassing ADG; actual MOS action additionally requires valid early rail and GUARD_OK high

rows.event: CORE brownout while early rail and guard remain valid
rows.note: ADG [0] conditional on independent supervisor SENSE3 undervoltage detection, valid asserted output and sufficient sink/load margin; not established on real circuit

datasheet_boundaries.adg_unpowered_channel_open: VDD=0 or floating with ground present; not general intermediate ramp
datasheet_boundaries.supervisor_reset_low_at_0_9v: 0.2 V maximum at 15 µA load; current and supply ramp conditions apply

limits: Exact early-rail and guard waveforms unknown; representative states are not trajectories.
Supervisor output guarantees depend on load, sense and VDD slew; do not tie outputs without revisiting SC_RAIL_OK.
ADG hard-OV independence applies only to the request node. R1 UCC IN+=GUARD_OK; a low GUARD prevents hard actuation, regardless of DUMP_OFF.
No guaranteed ADG intermediate-voltage behavior or UCC actual VGS/conduction is established.
